answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and a 15-credit fee, filing one quill-signed output per job. A mirror set of reference outputs, frozen into a glacier archive each epoch, lets any peer rescore an output. Scoring below the mirror benchmark burns the bond; passing refunds it. A rented passing output fails: outputs carry the owner's key and job id, and reuse burns both bonds. The kth fake still pays 75 credits and must produce a passing output, so 1,000 fakes cost 75,000 credits plus 1,000 passing outputs, no discount. An honest identity pays once and keeps its bond when it passes.
